purpose: Complete the rare-biology synthetic family with spatial-context and perturbation-response structural challenges. These are synthetic stress geometries, not claims that the same numerical effects have been measured in real human data.

spatial_stress_geometry.interpretation: Synthetic context-strength setting chosen prospectively after design calibration because real Stage81A3 assets establish context-value identifiability, not a numeric human context effect prior.
spatial_stress_geometry.shuffled_control_rule: Within-donor shuffled context may not contain the focal cell. The earlier leaky control was rejected during TDD before this freeze.

perturbation_stress_geometry.interpretation: Synthetic response-strength setting only; existing perturbation audits do not establish this as a measured universal microglial effect size.

design_calibration.spatial: After removing focal-cell leakage, intrinsic true-vs-shuffled advantage centered near zero across calibration seeds. Conditioned niche_fraction=0.35/niche_multiplier=8 produced a robust positive true-neighbor advantage. Calibration seeds are design-only and cannot serve as V3 qualification evidence.
design_calibration.perturbation: Calibration showed actual-arm shifts while matched null centered near zero; numerical thresholds were frozen before V3 seed realization.

real_evidence_boundary.spatial: SCP2167 plus eligible Fang STG MERFISH makes bounded real context-value qualification identifiable; actual context benefit has not yet been demonstrated.
real_evidence_boundary.perturbation: Authenticated perturbation assets support later directional consistency tests but do not define latent truth or universal causal effect size.
